Message:
tg3: fix warnings

In case CONFIG_PM_SLEEP is disabled, we dont need tg3_suspend() and
tg3_resume().

drivers/net/tg3.c:15056: warning: ‘tg3_suspend’ defined but not used
drivers/net/tg3.c:15110: warning: ‘tg3_resume’ defined but not used
